title: A different circle in every tile

tests.label: First column: 0.2 from a tile's center is outside (radius 0.1)
Last column: 0.35 from a tile's center is inside (radius 0.4)
Third column: 0.25 from the center is inside (radius 0.3)

predict.question: Which column is the pixel at **uv = (0.6, 0.1)** in? What is `id.x` there?
predict.explain: **2.** 0.6 × 4 = 2.4, so it's the third column (counting from 0). Its circle should have radius 0.1 + 0.1 × 2 = 0.3.
